options.content: **Azure · GCP · Railway** | Live provider metrics · refresh every 5 minutes · display time: Bangkok. Gaps mean unavailable samples, not zero. Cloud SQL is shared by DEV, PROD and the internal agent; its charts describe the whole instance.
